answer_text:
Published research tracking Perplexity's citation behavior does not isolate a single fixed total number of unique web domains for local business recommendation queries specifically in September 2026, though specific industry datasets outline its citation breadth and top source breakdowns:
Source & Dataset: Research published by Lighthouse Local (utilizing its running MentionedOn dataset covering 21 local service trades across 40 US cities with 34,740 total AI answers as of September 25, 2026) noted that Perplexity typically synthesized recommendations by drawing from a selection pool of 20 sources per local query set (such as local directories and the Better Business Bureau). www.lighthouselocal.ai
Broader Citation Studies: In broader multi-engine and platform studies from the same period—such as Surfer analyzing over 10.37 million Perplexity citations and UX Continuum's AI Source Study—Perplexity averaged 20.0 sources per answer, with review sites and directories accounting for roughly 21.6% to 37.1% of citations for local service and business queries. surfer.ai +1
Comparison Data: For context on localized domain spread, separate analysis by Seomatic tracking local queries across engines found that overall citation ecosystems spanned 2,031 unique domains across 2,519 total citations when looking broadly at local business response graphs. SEOmatic
